description:
Forecast sprint completion date from backlog size and historical velocity.

Computes average velocity from sprint history, converts story points to hours,
and returns required sprints with pessimistic estimate based on velocity variance. Use when planning a sprint completion date from backlog size and velocity history.

ai_native.description: Degree of AI assistance: 0.0 = fully human, 1.0 = fully AI-native, 0.5 = hybrid. Accepts boolean for backward compatibility (true=1.0, false=0.0).

backlog_points.description: Total story points or effort units remaining in the backlog.

hours_per_sprint.description: Total productive engineering hours available per sprint (accounts for meetings, overhead).

project.description: Optional project/repo identifier this estimate belongs to, for cross-project analytics.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier (minted by a calling agent/hook) used to deduplicate repeated estimate calls for the same task within a session.

sprint_length_days.description: Calendar days in a single sprint cycle.

task_label.description: Optional free-text label identifying the task this estimate is for (e.g. an issue key or short title). Surfaced on get_pending_estimates output for triage.

task_type.description: Optional task type for feedback matching.

velocity_history.description: Historical velocities from completed sprints. Minimum 1 data point; 3+ recommended for meaningful forecasts.

items.description: Velocity in points for a single sprint (must be > 0).

name: sprint_forecast
